headline: 1995 executive order on protecting people in research studies and creating a National Bioethics Advisory Commission.
what_it_does: Based on its title, this order deals with protecting people who take part in research studies, such as medical or scientific experiments. It also creates a new group called the National Bioethics Advisory Commission, which would advise on ethical questions in research. No summary was provided, so the specific rules and duties in the order are not described here.

who_it_affects.group: People who take part in research studies
who_it_affects.how: The order is aimed at protecting the safety and rights of people who volunteer or are enrolled as research subjects.

who_it_affects.group: Federal agencies that conduct or fund research involving people
who_it_affects.how: These agencies may be affected by the order's protections and by the new commission's advice.

when_it_takes_effect: Signed October 3, 1995; executive orders usually take effect when signed unless they say otherwise.
